name: 3913 transfer logic leaves skimmable surplus in its pairs
summary: 3913's transfer logic leaves 3913 in its PancakeSwap pairs above their recorded reserves; the attacker repeatedly skimmed the surplus into helper contracts and sold it, draining the pairs' USDT.
notes: Loss is the two pairs' USDT (0x71576290 and 0x5b4d39f3); their 3913 is valued at nothing (rule 12).
